title: Rav Gamda
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman notes that we always find that he spoke in Rava’s name, in Gittin 19b and Bava Kamma 72a; in Beitzah 7a Hyman reports the reading that he spoke in Rav’s name, and he proposes reading in Rava’s name. Hyman describes him as already the leading sage of the generation in Rav Ashi’s time, citing Ketubot 63b: Ameimar, Mar Zutra and Rav Ashi were sitting, and Rav Gamda was sitting with them. Rav Gamda said to them: “Because Rav Zevid is a great man, you flatter him? But Rav Kahana said…” In Bava Kamma 106a: “Rav Gamda went and told Rava’s teaching to Rav Ashi.”

Of his personal life we find in Nedarim 50a that Rav Gamda gave zuz to sailors to buy something for him; they bought him a monkey, and it fled from them and went into a hole. They chased after it and found a great treasure there, and they brought everything to Rav Gamda.

notes.text: מקורותיו הפרטים is understood as personal life here, not personal textual sources. Hyman’s always assertion and Rav/Rava correction remain attributed. Saved Davidson Bava Kamma106a separately contains the Ashi exchange.
